# Going Endo

> Find the AI worth doing. Going Endo helps leadership teams choose the AI use case that pays off for the business and the people it depends on, then build it.

Going Endo is available in the United States, the United Arab Emirates, Singapore, the United Kingdom, and Switzerland, online or in person. The name means "going within": we work inside your company and your industry.

Going Endo sells no software. It helps you choose the right AI first, then builds it through an AI Sprint with trusted specialist partners. Going Endo manages the project and stays accountable to you.

## Status

Not yet launched. Going Endo is inviting its first partners and clients now.

## How it works

1. AI Workshop: a half day with your leadership team.
2. AI Opportunity Brief: one page with the problem, the payoff, and the smallest test.
3. AI Sprint: we build it and test it with our specialists.

Common AI uses by industry (examples, not results; the workshop finds the right one for each company):

- Manufacturing: predict breakdowns before they happen; cut energy use on the line; spot defects with cameras.
- Logistics: plan smarter delivery routes; forecast demand ahead of time; automate the paperwork.
- Healthcare: draft visit notes automatically; predict missed appointments; answer patient questions around the clock.
- Professional services: draft proposals and reports faster; find past work instantly; sort and prioritize leads.
- Financial services: flag fraud sooner; speed up loan reviews; answer customer questions instantly.
- Construction: estimate jobs faster; spot safety risks in site photos; track materials on every job.

## Offers

- AI Briefing: a single online session for the member companies of an association, chamber, or innovation agency. It shows what AI can do in their industry right now. There is no cost to the host organization.
- AI Workshop: an online or in person workshop for one company's leadership team. You leave with an AI Opportunity Brief for one AI use case: the value to your business and the people it affects, the risks, and a plan to test it. Workshop details come in a first conversation.
- AI Sprint: a focused project that builds and tests the use case from your AI Opportunity Brief. Specialist partners build it; Going Endo manages the project. Scope and price are agreed after the workshop.

## Who it is for

Leadership teams of established companies, and the associations, chambers, and agencies that support them.

## Technologies

AI first. Then connected devices, robotics, and immersive technology where they fit.
